Apache Kafka
Event Broker

KRaft mode · Port 9092
UI: Port 8080

Topics:
trade.raw
trade.accepted
trade.enriched (+ templateId)
stp.validated
confirmation.generated
exception.created (1..N)
exception.classified
workitem.linked
manual.review.required
deadletter.trade

Synthetic Trade
Producer / Seed Loader
FpML-inspired JSON
CSV / JSON seed files

Java Ingestion Service
Port 8081
FR1: Event intake
FR2: Schema validation
FR3: Raw persistence
REST API: GET /trades/{id}
GET /trades?status=&page=

Mock Reference Data
instrument / counterparty / templates
CSV / JSON files
template catalogue (templateId)
product eligibility, SLA config

Enrichment Service
Port 8082
FR4: Reference-data enrichment
Resolves templateId from catalogue
REST API: GET /enrichment/{tradeId}

STP Validation & Rules Engine
Port 8083
FR5: STP rules engine
FR6: Confirmation generation
Decision: OK or FAIL
Computes STP rate → CouchDB stp-metrics
REST API: GET /metrics/stp-rate

Confirmation Generator
inside Validation Service
1. Reads templateId from trade.enriched
2. Fetches template from Mock Ref Data
3. Renders HTML/Text output
4. Writes to CouchDB confirmations DB
status: GENERATED → DISPATCHED
5. Publishes confirmation.generated

Confirmation Status Lifecycle:
GENERATED → DISPATCHED → ACKNOWLEDGED
↘ DISPUTED (→ exception.created)

React + TypeScript Operations UI
Port 3000 (Nginx) | READ dashboards only
FR11: Trade lifecycle, Exception list
Aged items, Root-cause themes
STP rate (from /metrics/stp-rate)
SLA risk (from /workitems/sla-risk)
Manual review screen
Replay queue + audit history

REST calls to backend services:
ingestion:8081, exception:8084
workitem:8085, validation:8083

WRITE: PATCH /workitems/{id}/status
(status update → workitem-service)

STP Rate:
confirmed / total processed
Written to CouchDB stp-metrics
Exposed: GET /metrics/stp-rate

Exception Service
Port 8084
FR7: Exception capture (1..N per trade)
FR8: Classification (category+sub-theme)
FR9: Recommendation engine
Sources: validation, ingestion,
enrichment, technical failures
REST API: GET /exceptions?tradeId=

1..N exceptions per trade:
e.g. missing notional AND missing template
= two separate exception records published

Classification & Recommendation Engine
inside Exception Service
FR8 Categories + Sub-themes:
1. Missing economic data
↳ Strike null / Notional missing / Premium absent
2. Missing static/ref data
↳ Counterparty unknown / Template not found
3. Template issue
↳ No matching template / Product mismatch
4. Business rule failure
↳ Client not STP-eligible / Rule version mismatch
5. Technical processing failure
↳ Timeout / Parse error / Duplicate event
6. Counterparty/matching dispute
↳ Economic discrepancy / Non-econ mismatch
Outputs: confidenceScore, reasonCode[]

exception.classified payload:
{ exceptionId, tradeId, category,
subTheme, confidenceScore: 0.0-1.0,
reasonCode: ["STRIKE_NULL",...],
ownerQueue, priority, difficulty,
replayMayHelp: true|false }

READ: volume count + age
(for FR9 priority scoring)

FR9 Priority Scoring inputs:
1. Operational impact (notional)
2. Age = now - createdTimestamp (CouchDB read)
3. Volume = count similar exceptions (CouchDB _find)
4. Resolution difficulty (rule table)
replayMayHelp=true if category=TECHNICAL

Work Item Service (Linker)
Port 8085
FR10: Create OR link work item
• Check: open WI for tradeId/category?
• YES → link exception to existing WI
• NO → create new WI (local ID: WI-xxx)
FR12: Audit trail + DLQ handling
Computes SLA risk (aged open exceptions)
REST API: GET /workitems/sla-risk
REST API: PATCH /workitems/{id}/status

Create OR Link logic:
CouchDB query: open WI for tradeId+category?
→ YES: add exceptionId to WI.exceptions[]
→ NO: create WI {id, tradeId, category,
ownerQueue, priority, status: OPEN}

SLA Risk:
Scan CouchDB for WIs with status=OPEN
and age > SLA threshold (from ref-data config)
Exposed: GET /workitems/sla-risk

Manual Review Queue
manual.review.required
Routed to manual review
Supervisor approval required

Retry Policy (all services)
Tier 1: Immediate retry × 2
Tier 2: Exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s)
Tier 3: → deadletter.trade (irrecoverable)
Each tier logs to audit-events

Dead-letter Queue
deadletter.trade topic
Any service — after retry tiers exhausted

deadletter.trade payload contract:
{ originalTopic, originalPayload,
failureReason, retryCount: 3,
lastAttemptTimestamp, serviceName,
correlationId, tradeId }

Replay Controls
FR12: Controlled replay
Supervisor role required
Safety check before replay

Replay Safety Rules:
1. Root cause must be marked FIXED
2. Supervisor must approve (role check)
3. Idempotency: tradeId as CouchDB doc ID
(second write overwrites, no duplicates)
4. Audit event written before re-publish

Observability:
metrics / logs / traces
Correlation IDs (traceId)
/actuator/health per service
Structured JSON logs
p50/p95 latency metrics

Audit Trail
immutable events
Every status transition captured
CouchDB audit-events (append-only)
Retry attempts logged per tier

common-lib (shared Maven module) — Used by all 5 backend services
FpML-inspired JSON DTOs · Kafka event contracts · Exception category enums · DLQ payload schema · Confirmation status enum

Key NFRs
SLA: ≤10s end-to-end
Volume: 1M trades/day
Peak: 100K trades/hour
Horizontal consumer scaling
Partition key: tradeId
Idempotent writes to CouchDB

Team Ownership
Mayank → ingestion-service
Gunjan → enrichment-service
Mahadev → validation-service
Kapish → exception-service
Bhavik → workitem-service (DevOps)
Oren → frontend + QA
